conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the Sdn Bhd legal form. The usual private limited company form.

profileFields.label: Registration No.
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Share capital
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Runs the company and represents it.

roles.label: Shareholder
roles.description: Owns shares or a stake in the company.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the Sdn Bhd name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Registry of Companies and Business Names and follows Brunei's naming rules.
setupSteps.authority: Registry of Companies and Business Names

setupSteps.title: Prepare the Sdn Bhd documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Registry of Companies and Business Names

setupSteps.title: Register the Sdn Bhd
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Registry of Companies and Business Names requires. The company exists once the register enters it.
setupSteps.authority: Registry of Companies and Business Names

setupSteps.title: Register the Sdn Bhd for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance and Economy for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance and Economy

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Employees Trust Fund for payroll and social contributions.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Registry of Companies and Business Names, then file it and keep the company record current.
obligations.authority: Registry of Companies and Business Names

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Registry of Companies and Business Names, the deadline and whether an audit is required.
obligations.authority: Registry of Companies and Business Names

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance and Economy, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.
obligations.authority: Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance and Economy

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance and Economy and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.
obligations.authority: Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance and Economy

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Employees Trust Fund. Check the rates and dates.

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Registry of Companies and Business Names.
obligations.authority: Registry of Companies and Business Names

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Registry of Companies and Business Names, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.
obligations.authority: Registry of Companies and Business Names

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
